BE IT ORDAINED BY TITE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. fitle 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning Ordinance, is
hereby amended by changing all the current M2-3 Light Industry District symbols and indications
as shown on Map No. 4-F in the area bounded by:

              A line 100.0 feet north of and parallel to West CuUerton Street; a line 184.0 feet
              east of and parallel to South Jefferson Street; West CuUerton Street; and a line
              160.0 feet east of and parallel to South Jefferson Street.

to those of a B2-2, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This Ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and due
publication.


Address: 554 W. CuUerton St.
                                    NARRATIVE AND PLANS
                                      554 W. CuUerton St.
                                    TYPE 1 REGULATIONS

Narrative: The subject property is improved with a two story residendal building with two
residential dwelling units. The Applicant seeks to rezone the property from a M2-3 Light Industry
District to a B2-2 Neighborhood Mixed-Use District to constmct a new two story residential
building with two residential dwelling units. There will be no parking. The proposed height of
the building will be 23'-2". The Applicant will seek relief for reduction in parking.

Lot Area:                     2,400 square feet

FAR:                          0.75

Floor Area:                   1,814 square feet

Residential Dwelling Units: 2

MLA:                          1,200 square feet

Height:                       23'-2" feet

Automobile Parking:           0*

Setbacks:
       Front (West CuUerton):                14'-6"feet
       East Side:                            4'-0" feet
       Westside:                             1'-3" feet
       Rear;                                 27'-8" feet **



A set of plans is attached.

* The Applicant will seek relief to reduce parking.
** The Applicant will seek relief to reduce the rear yard setback from the required 30'-0" feet to
27'-8" feet.
